title: Higher-Spin Correlators in dS
summary: We study momentum-space correlators in minimal higher-spin gravity in $\mathrm{dS}_4$ using its holographic vector-model description. Connected $n$-point functions in this model are represented by three-dimensional one-loop integrals and are rational functions of the boundary kinematics. We show that the four-point function displays a nontrivial geometric feature: its physical singularity is governed by a Ptolemy relation for the dual momentum quadrilateral.
